title: NTL Basketball All-Star teams announced - NewsBreak
text:
By Andy Malnoske No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
ELMIRA, N.Y. (WETM) – The Northern Tier League (NTL) announced its annual All-Star selections in basketball.
Plus, the MVP’s for both boys and girls leagues were revealed. Below, a full list of each All-Star along with individual awards courtesy of Circle W Sports.
NTL Boys Basketball
Player of the Year: Elli Stanton, Northeast Bradford
Offensive Player of the Year: Trey Teribury, Troy
Defensive Player of the Year: James Friend, Athens
6th Man: Dayton Russell, Northeast Bradford
Coaching Staff of the Year: Northeast Bradford
Large School Division
First Team
Andy Hermansen, North Penn-Mansfield
Jason Harer, North Penn-Mansfield
Colin Fletcher, Wellsboro
Lucas Schultz, Athens
Boom Thompson, Towanda
Darrius Farrell, Towanda
